text_block_list.text:
Despite putting up a good fight, Mejiro 
Bright fell just one step short of 
Matikanefukukitaru.

However, her running can hold its own even 
over long distances. Taking this result 
into account, which path should she take: 
long distance or medium distance—

First, in the Stayers Stakes, they decided 
to test Mejiro Bright's talent as a 
stayer.
